band_distinctness.note: A collapsed band empties part of the three-band decomposition. Reported rather than silently tolerated.

band_pinning.decline: cost minimisation, floored at friction (narrowest, highest)
band_pinning.friction: per-rail friction cap (BROADEST band, lowest threshold)
band_pinning.review: staffed alert budget, spent on the band [t_review, t_decline)
band_pinning.why: Each band is pinned by the constraint that governs it. Deriving all three from one quantile collapses them into a single threshold and empties the three-band decomposition the metrics table requires.

capacity_report.realised_review_band_note: The REVIEW BAND is [t_review, t_decline). The budget is spent on the band, not on the whole tail, because rows at or above t_decline are declined rather than queued.

decline_report.constraint: total cost minimisation subject to t_decline >= t_friction
decline_report.cost_terms: chargeback loss + handling + interchange forgone + friction abandonment + review cost + THE LIFETIME COST OF A FALSE DECLINE, which is the term most models omit and the term an issuer cares about most.

friction_report.constraint: per-rail friction cap spent on the BAND [t_friction, t_review), not on the whole rail tail, then clamped to t_review so the cap can never escalate a rail

bloom_exchange.verify_note: Real-world availability and regulatory permissibility are UNVERIFIED. If shared beneficiary signals are unobtainable, GATE-B degrades to a single-institution inbound-credit scorer with materially weaker recall, and the visibility ablation is the thing that quantifies exactly how much weaker.

conformal_coverage.exchangeability_note: Time-forward payment data VIOLATES exchangeability (Barber, Candes, Ramdas & Tibshirani, Annals of Statistics 2023), so the nominal conformal guarantee does not hold here. We therefore MEASURE coverage rather than assume it, and publish the gap per stratum.

density.unit_note: The RAW score is a SUM of per-feature negative-log tail probabilities over 316 features, so its natural scale is ~237, NOT a z-score. Comparing the raw score against a z-threshold flags every row. Use score_z() or score_quantile().

calibrator.note: Applied AFTER the undersampling prior correction. An uncalibrated score cannot be fed a cost matrix, and an unfitted calibrator acts as the identity rather than inventing a mapping.

fusion.combine_rule: weighted arithmetic mean of ECDF ranks
fusion.design_position: Rank-average plus isotonic, DELIBERATELY not a learned stacker. With simulator-derived fraud counts a stacker overfits, and a promotion gate judged against a false-positive budget we generated ourselves is not a gate.

label_maturity_stats.note: Reported with EVERY window. Recall against 30% matured labels and recall against 100% are not the same metric; the unlabelled share is what the nnPU / Elkan-Noto correction is applied to, because absence of a label is not evidence of legitimacy.

label_maturity_train.note: Reported with EVERY window. Recall against 30% matured labels and recall against 100% are not the same metric; the unlabelled share is what the nnPU / Elkan-Noto correction is applied to, because absence of a label is not evidence of legitimacy.

nearline.consequence: The mimicry flag (G3) and learned graph embeddings (G4) are absent. The inline sketch counters still provide graph SIGNAL at t=0 — that is the cold-graph fix and it does not depend on G4. The delta is reported rather than the claim restated.

onboarding_scorer.design_only_note: The list above is NOT IN THE ARTIFACT and is badged design-only in the UI and on the slide. Those signals are real observables and belong in the taxonomy; we do not build liveness or document forensics and we produce no bypass knowledge.

queue_ceiling.note: The review band alone cannot exceed this recall BEFORE precision is even discussed. Reported at every swept base rate, because the ceiling moves with the base rate.

reference_stats.causality_note: Fitted on the TRAINING WINDOW ONLY with holdout-family rows excluded, then frozen and applied forward. eval/leakage/statistic_fit.py asserts it.

registry.note: This count is MACHINE-COUNTED from features/registry.yaml. The design's ~380 is a planned budget; what ships is whatever this prints.

protected_attribute_policy.asserted: No feature in this registry encodes age, gender, religion, caste, income, or any direct proxy for them. Geography features are TRANSACTION geography (acceptor geo cell, geohash of the payment) rather than residence, and issuer/BIN features are institutional rather than personal.
protected_attribute_policy.residual_risk: Geography and device tier CAN correlate with socio-economic status. We do not claim otherwise; we publish a disparate-impact table over decline, friction AND beneficiary-side hold/freeze rates by segment, geography and device tier so the correlation is measurable rather than denied. That table's segments are synthetic attributes we generated, so it demonstrates the reporting machinery exists — not that a real portfolio is fair.

batched_fetch.note: ONE round trip for all nine keys. This is the decision that makes the latency target reachable at all; bench/ measures the unbatched cost for comparison.

sketch_footprint.degradation_policy: Feature-fetch timeout at N ms -> the NAMED reduced feature vector -> G0-only. p99 is re-measured under injected store latency so the fallback has a number.
sketch_footprint.footprint_statement: Footprint is reported as values-per-entity-per-key-type x active entities, never as a round total, because a round total hides which key type dominates.

split.policy: TIME-FORWARD ONLY. No random splits anywhere. The STATS window is a fifth holdout channel used only for reference statistics, the calibrator and the conformal calibration set, so no threshold inherits the training window's prevalence.
